crown_archive_source: Locally held, independently verified Crown quote and FT archive; no M3/M1/MR1 predictions, parameters, orders, or ledger values were read.
time_method: Exact fixture join; select the latest verified Crown quote strictly before independently verified UTC kickoff; settle against verified FT after kickoff.
prediction_timing_limitation: M3 strict season-forward forecasts were generated retrospectively from historical results; they were not contemporaneously recorded at quote time.
selection_method: Per fixture, choose the model-implied higher expected-return side at the available exact market line; no EV or confidence threshold. One unit per fixture. AH and OU are evaluated separately.
limitations: These 24 AH and 36 OU observations are small and overlapping fixtures are possible; market samples must not be combined.
All bootstrap intervals cross zero and are descriptive, not evidence of persistent edge.
No execution, slippage, limits, or fill receipts are present; results are unit-stake replay, not realized trading ROI.
Historical Crown quotes are actual pre-kickoff snapshots, but M3 predictions are retrospective strict-OOS hindcasts rather than forecasts recorded at those times.
This replay does not establish the scope of provider written permission for new API collection or public quote retention.
